BRIDGE_NAME.label: Bridge name
BRIDGE_NAME.help: Shown in Music Assistant next to each player. Leave empty to use the host name.

TZ.label: Time zone
TZ.help: IANA name, for example Europe/Berlin. Used for log and event times.

WEB_PORT.label: Web port
WEB_PORT.help: Port of this web interface. Empty uses the WEB_PORT environment variable or 8080. Takes effect after a restart.

LOG_LEVEL.label: Log level
LOG_LEVEL.help: DEBUG writes much more detail; use it while investigating a problem.

SENDSPIN_SERVER.label: Music Assistant server
SENDSPIN_SERVER.help: Host name or IP address of Music Assistant, or auto to find it on the network.

BASE_LISTEN_PORT.label: First player port
BASE_LISTEN_PORT.help: Speakers listen on consecutive ports from here. Empty picks free ports automatically.

SENDSPIN_PAIRING.label: Require pairing
SENDSPIN_PAIRING.help: Music Assistant must enter a PIN before it can play to these speakers.

SENDSPIN_OWN_SERVER_ONLY.label: Only this bridge's Music Assistant
SENDSPIN_OWN_SERVER_ONLY.help: Turn away any other Music Assistant that tries to take a speaker. Applies once the bridge knows its own Music Assistant (a server address or the Music Assistant API URL).

VOLUME_VIA_MA.label: Volume through Music Assistant
VOLUME_VIA_MA.help: Volume changes go through Music Assistant so its sliders stay in step.

MUTE_VIA_MA.label: Mute through Music Assistant
MUTE_VIA_MA.help: Muting goes through Music Assistant so its players show the same state.

MA_WEBSOCKET_MONITOR.label: Live updates from Music Assistant
MA_WEBSOCKET_MONITOR.help: Keep a connection open for now playing, queue and group changes.

MA_AUTO_SILENT_AUTH.label: Renew sign-in automatically
MA_AUTO_SILENT_AUTH.help: Refresh the Music Assistant sign-in in the background when it expires.

DUPLICATE_DEVICE_CHECK.label: Warn about speakers on other bridges
DUPLICATE_DEVICE_CHECK.help: Ask Music Assistant whether another bridge already serves the same speaker.

PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC.label: Audio buffer
PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC.help: Higher values survive busy hosts and virtual machines; lower values react faster.

PREFER_SBC_CODEC.label: Prefer SBC codec
PREFER_SBC_CODEC.help: Use SBC instead of AAC or aptX. Helps speakers that stutter with other codecs.

SMOOTH_RESTART.label: Smooth restarts
SMOOTH_RESTART.help: Reconnect a speaker's player instead of restarting it from scratch.

DISABLE_PA_RESCUE_STREAMS.label: Stop PulseAudio moving streams
DISABLE_PA_RESCUE_STREAMS.help: Unload module-rescue-streams so a reconnecting speaker never borrows another's audio.

PULSE_SINK_RESET_ON_START.label: Wake audio outputs on start
PULSE_SINK_RESET_ON_START.help: Suspend and resume each local audio output once before its player first starts. Helps an output that comes up silent.

BT_CHECK_INTERVAL.label: Connection check interval
BT_CHECK_INTERVAL.help: How often the bridge checks that each speaker is still connected.

BT_MAX_RECONNECT_FAILS.label: Reconnect attempts
BT_MAX_RECONNECT_FAILS.help: Failed reconnects in a row before the bridge stops trying. 0 keeps trying.

RSSI_BADGE.label: Signal strength
RSSI_BADGE.help: Show live signal strength on each connected speaker.

BT_CHURN_THRESHOLD.label: Reconnect loop limit
BT_CHURN_THRESHOLD.help: Connect/disconnect cycles within the window that make the bridge pause a speaker. 0 turns this off.

BT_CHURN_WINDOW.label: Reconnect loop window
BT_CHURN_WINDOW.help: Time window for counting those cycles.

EXPERIMENTAL_A2DP_SINK_RECOVERY_DANCE.label: Recover a missing audio sink
EXPERIMENTAL_A2DP_SINK_RECOVERY_DANCE.help: Experimental. Disconnect and reconnect a speaker whose audio output never appears.

EXPERIMENTAL_PA_MODULE_RELOAD.label: Reload the PulseAudio Bluetooth module
EXPERIMENTAL_PA_MODULE_RELOAD.help: Experimental. Last resort when PulseAudio stops creating Bluetooth outputs.

EXPERIMENTAL_ADAPTER_AUTO_RECOVERY.label: Reset a stuck adapter
EXPERIMENTAL_ADAPTER_AUTO_RECOVERY.help: Experimental. After the reconnect attempts run out, power-cycle or reset the Bluetooth adapter.

mode.label: Connection to Home Assistant
mode.help: MQTT publishes entities through your broker; Integration uses the Sendspin Bridge custom integration.

broker.label: MQTT broker
broker.help: Host name or IP, or auto to use the Mosquitto add-on.

tls.label: Use TLS
tls.help: Encrypt the connection to the broker.

username.label: MQTT user
username.help: Leave empty when the broker allows anonymous clients.

password.label: MQTT password
password.help: Stored on the bridge and never shown again.

discovery_prefix.label: Discovery prefix
discovery_prefix.help: Must match Home Assistant's MQTT discovery prefix.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Empty derives one from the bridge.

advertise_mdns.label: Announce on the network
advertise_mdns.help: Let Home Assistant discover the bridge and offer the integration.

supervisor_pair.label: Pair through the Supervisor
supervisor_pair.help: On Home Assistant OS the integration gets its token without copying it by hand.

advertise_host.label: Announced address
advertise_host.help: The address Home Assistant uses to reach the bridge. Set it when the bridge sits behind a reverse proxy or NAT; empty detects it.

HA_AREA_NAME_ASSIST_ENABLED.label: Room names from areas
HA_AREA_NAME_ASSIST_ENABLED.help: Suggest room names for speakers from Home Assistant areas.

AUTH_ENABLED.label: Require sign-in
AUTH_ENABLED.help: Ask for a password or account before showing this interface.

BRUTE_FORCE_PROTECTION.label: Lock out repeated failures
BRUTE_FORCE_PROTECTION.help: Block sign-in for a while after too many wrong passwords.

BRUTE_FORCE_MAX_ATTEMPTS.label: Failed attempts allowed
BRUTE_FORCE_MAX_ATTEMPTS.help: Wrong passwords within the window before the lockout starts.

BRUTE_FORCE_WINDOW_MINUTES.label: Counting window
BRUTE_FORCE_WINDOW_MINUTES.help: Time over which failed attempts are counted.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.label: Trusted proxies
TRUSTED_PROXIES.help: One IP address per line. Only these may tell the bridge the real client address.

CHECK_UPDATES.label: Check for updates
CHECK_UPDATES.help: Look for new versions in the background.

UPDATE_CHANNEL.label: Update channel
UPDATE_CHANNEL.help: Stable for everyday use; release candidates and betas arrive earlier and may break.

AUTO_UPDATE.label: Install updates automatically
AUTO_UPDATE.help: Install a new version on the chosen channel as soon as it is found.

STARTUP_BANNER_GRACE_SECONDS.label: Startup grace period
STARTUP_BANNER_GRACE_SECONDS.help: Wait this long after start before showing setup hints.

RECOVERY_BANNER_GRACE_SECONDS.label: Recovery grace period
RECOVERY_BANNER_GRACE_SECONDS.help: Wait this long before suggesting fixes for a speaker that dropped.

maConnection.label: Music Assistant account
maConnection.help: Sign in so the bridge can show groups and now playing and control the queue.

sendspinTest.label: Sendspin connection
sendspinTest.help: Check that the bridge reaches Music Assistant with the server and port above.

adapters.label: Adapters
adapters.help: Give adapters a name you recognise. Device class is a workaround for speakers that refuse unknown computers; leave it empty unless you need it.
adapters.name: Name
adapters.deviceClassHelp: Six-digit hex, for example 0x00010c (laptop). Empty keeps the system default.

ha.publisherHelp: Publishes the bridge and its speakers as Home Assistant entities.
ha.mosquittoMissing: Home Assistant has no MQTT broker yet. Install the Mosquitto add-on, then set the broker to auto.
ha.brokerHelp: Find the broker automatically, or test the address and credentials below before saving.
ha.notDetected: No broker found; enter it by hand.
ha.testOk: The broker accepted the connection ({ms} ms).
ha.componentMissing: Install the integration from HACS, then add it in Home Assistant.
ha.mdnsHelp: Home Assistant finds the bridge through this announcement.

areaMap.label: Rooms by adapter
areaMap.help: Speakers on an adapter get its room. The area ID is the last part of the area's address in Home Assistant (Settings → Areas).

password.label: Password
password.set: A password is set for signing in to this interface.
password.notSet: No password yet. Create one before requiring sign-in.

tokens.label: API tokens
tokens.help: For the Home Assistant integration and your own scripts: send as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
tokens.once: Copy this token now. It is not shown again.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token? Anything using it stops working.

updates.label: Version {version}
updates.upToDate: No newer version found on this channel.

backup.exportHelp: Download the configuration with passwords and tokens removed.
backup.importHelp: Replace the configuration with a file exported earlier. Secrets already on the bridge are kept.
backup.rawHelp: For keys this screen does not show. Changes are saved with the Save button.

settings.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved settings. Leave anyway?

name.label: Name
name.help: Shown as the player in Music Assistant.

adapter.label: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.help: The adapter that connects this speaker. Automatic uses the default adapter.

sink.label: Audio output
sink.help: The sound output of this computer this player plays to. Outputs another player uses are not offered.

room_name.label: Room
room_name.help: Shown with the player and offered to Home Assistant.

room_id.label: Home Assistant area ID
room_id.help: Links the speaker to an area in Home Assistant.

volume_controller.label: Volume control
volume_controller.help: PulseAudio changes the system volume of the speaker; Sendspin scales the audio stream instead.

listen_port.label: Player port
listen_port.help: Port Music Assistant connects to for this speaker. Empty picks one automatically.

idle_mode.label: When idle
idle_mode.help: What the bridge does while nothing plays.

power_save_delay_minutes.label: Release audio after
power_save_delay_minutes.help: Free the speaker's audio connection after this long without sound.

idle_disconnect_minutes.label: Disconnect after
idle_disconnect_minutes.help: Disconnect Bluetooth after this long without sound. 0 never disconnects.

keep_alive_method.label: Keep-awake signal
keep_alive_method.help: An inaudible 2 Hz tone suits most speakers; silence helps the few that react to the tone.

static_delay_ms.label: Speaker delay
static_delay_ms.help: How late this speaker plays its sound. The bridge sends audio this much earlier so it stays in time with the group.

min_buffer_ms.label: Minimum buffer
min_buffer_ms.help: Audio the speaker keeps queued while playing.

required_lead_time_ms.label: Start-up lead time
required_lead_time_ms.help: Time the speaker needs before the first sound plays.

clicks.label: Click track
clicks.help: Plays steady clicks in time with the group, so you can hear which speaker is late.

mic.label: Measure with a microphone
mic.help: Compares this speaker with another one through your phone or computer microphone. Keep the device still between both speakers.
mic.needPeer: Needs a second connected speaker to compare with.
mic.needHttps: The browser only allows the microphone over HTTPS or on localhost.
mic.not_detected: The clicks were not heard clearly. Move closer and try again.
mic.unstable: The measurements disagreed. Keep the device still and try again.
mic.confirm: Measured offset {offset} ms (spread {spread} ms). Set {name}'s delay to {value} ms?

history.title: Recent timing
history.empty: No timing samples yet; they appear while the speaker plays.

report.label: Diagnostics report
report.help: Everything a bug report needs, with secrets removed.

timeline.label: Recovery timeline
timeline.help: Startup and device events as CSV.

hooks.title: Webhooks
hooks.help: The bridge POSTs device and bridge events to these addresses. They last until the bridge restarts.

sync.loadError: Could not read the group members ({code}).

actions.title: Tune
actions.manualHelp: No microphone needed. Best for small fixes you can hear.
actions.semiHelp: About a minute per speaker. You hear and adjust the measured delays before you finish.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Save the current delays to come back to them later.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.noChanges: None of the group's speakers are in this profile.
profiles.deleteMessage: The delays stay as they are; only the saved profile is removed.

listen.title: Listen
listen.soloHelp: Pick a speaker to hear it alone (the others are muted), or Everyone.
listen.abHelp: Two speakers take turns every two clicks.
listen.needsClicks: Play the clicks to hear speakers alone or compare them.
listen.playHelp: Plays the click track on the group (3 minutes; play it again whenever it stops). Your queue is kept. Stop clicks stops only the click track.

manual.title: Delays
manual.help: A larger delay makes a speaker play earlier. Changes are written at once.
manual.reset: Put back the delays from the start
manual.resetDone: Delays are back to where this tuning started.
manual.busy: A measurement is running for this group. Finish it on the Measure tab first.
manual.saveOnLeave: Save these delays as a profile?
manual.saveOnLeaveHelp: The delays stay as they are either way.
manual.writeForbidden: Music Assistant refused to change {name}: this account has no permission to change player settings.
manual.writeFailed: Could not change {name} ({code}). The delay shown is what Music Assistant holds.
manual.ended: This tuning ended (it timed out, or was closed on another device). The delays stay as they are.
manual.endedNotice: Manual tuning ended: the delays stay; the clicks stopped, every speaker is unmuted and the volumes are back.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot record here. The microphone needs HTTPS (or localhost) and a current browser.
errors.permission: Microphone access was denied. Allow the microphone for this page in the browser settings and try again.
errors.no_microphone: No microphone was found on this device.
errors.mic_busy: The microphone is in use by another app or could not be started.
errors.worklet: The recording module could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
errors.interrupted: Audio was interrupted (the page was in the background or another app took the audio). Tap to continue; the affected speakers are measured again.
errors.timeout: The recording did not finish in time.
errors.mic_lost: The microphone stopped (unplugged, or access was withdrawn). Open it again to continue; the affected speakers are measured again.

notice.title: Nothing else plays while you measure.
notice.help: You stop the group's music first; then the click track plays on the group. While a speaker is measured, the others are muted. When you finish, every speaker the bridge muted is unmuted, the volumes go back to what they were and the clicks stop.
notice.queue: Your queue is kept: the click track plays in between and is taken out of the queue at the end. If Music Assistant refuses that, it stays in the queue as “Sendspin sync clicks”.

point.deviceHelp: Hold the phone near each speaker in turn. 6 s per speaker; lines up the devices themselves.
point.positionHelp: Stay where you usually listen. 12 s per speaker; includes the sound's travel to you.

wizard.micPermission: The browser will ask for the microphone. Recordings stay in memory and are only sent to this bridge.
wizard.holdStill: Tip: keep the room quiet and hold the phone still while it records.
wizard.byEar: You can still tune by ear:

level.help: The microphone meter should jump with each click.
level.tooQuiet: Too quiet: turn the group up or move closer.
level.tooLoud: Too loud: turn the group down a little or move away.

members.help: Measure each speaker on its own. You can repeat any speaker.
members.order: The order is only for your convenience (walk the room); it does not change the result.
members.left: Record or skip every speaker to continue ({n} left). | Record or skip every speaker to continue ({n} left).

hint.notHeard: Not heard: turn {name} up or move closer, then Repeat — or Skip it.
hint.unstable: Unstable: keep the room quiet and the phone still, then Repeat — or Skip it.

wizard.restartRound: The microphone clock was interrupted, so record the speakers marked “Record again” once more.
wizard.micLost: The microphone stopped (unplugged, or access was withdrawn).
wizard.ended: The measurement ended (it timed out, or was closed on another device). The speakers it muted are unmuted and its clicks stopped.
wizard.toTune: Apply the measured delays and listen
wizard.memberGone: {name} left the group; the measurement goes on without it.
wizard.proposalFailed: Could not work out the delays ({code}).

tune.help: The measured delays are applied and the clicks keep playing. Listen to each speaker alone or compare two, adjust any delay by hand, then finish.
tune.spread: Largest gap between speakers: {before} ms measured → about {after} ms now.
tune.kept: Not heard or skipped, so their delay is unchanged: {names}
tune.ready: The measured delays are applied. Listen and adjust.

cancel.title: Stop measuring?
cancel.message: Recordings so far will be lost. Speakers the bridge muted are unmuted, volumes go back and the clicks stop.
cancel.tuneTitle: Stop and put the delays back?
cancel.tuneMessage: The delays go back to what they were before you measured. Speakers the bridge muted are unmuted, volumes go back and the clicks stop.
cancel.done: Measurement cancelled. Speakers unmuted, volumes put back, clicks stopped.

reloaded.manual: Manual tuning ended when the page was reloaded. The delays stay as they were.
reloaded.measure: The measurement ended when the page was reloaded.

joinManual.title: Manual tuning is open on another device
joinManual.help: Join it to listen and adjust from here, or end it. Leaving this page never ends it.

sync.readOnly: Tuning in progress on another device
sync.readOnlyHelp: This page only shows the group until that tuning ends.
sync.restoreRetrying: Music Assistant could not be reached ({code}), so some speakers may still be muted or playing clicks. The bridge keeps trying.

proposal.name: Profile name
proposal.clampedWarning: Some delays were clamped to 0–5000 ms; the gap that remains is about {ms} ms.
proposal.largeWarning: A delay above 2000 ms needs Music Assistant to send audio far ahead; speakers with small buffers may drop out.
proposal.forbidden: Music Assistant refused to change the delays: this account may not change player settings. Set these values by hand in Music Assistant:
proposal.forbiddenHint: Or reconnect Music Assistant with an administrator account in the bridge settings and try again.
proposal.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the values and copy them by hand.

done.restoringHelp: Putting the volumes back, unmuting the speakers and stopping the clicks. The delays stay as you left them.
done.restoredHelp: Every speaker is unmuted, the volumes are back and the clicks stopped. The new delays stay; start your music again in Music Assistant.
done.spread: Largest gap between speakers: {before} ms → about {after} ms
done.saveFailed: The delays are kept, but the profile could not be saved ({code}).
done.listenHelp: Clicks play on the whole group for 10 s, then stop.
done.listening: Clicks playing on the whole group…
done.queue: Your queue is as it was. If a “Sendspin sync clicks” item is still in it, remove it in Music Assistant.

sync.endForeignTitle: End the tuning on the other device?
sync.endForeignMessage: Its clicks stop and the group is restored. Delays already written stay as they are.

signal.restarted: The clicks started again: record every speaker once more.

stop.help: The group must be silent before the clicks start: nothing else may play while the speakers are measured.
stop.stillPlaying: The group is still playing. Stop it to go on.
stop.notPlaying: The group is not playing — moving on.

clicker.help: The click track plays on every speaker of the group through Music Assistant for 3 minutes. If it stops, start it again.
clicker.groupPlaying: The group plays something else: stop it first.
clicker.whyDisabled: Start the clicks to go on.

volume.help: Set a level where the clicks are clearly audible where you measure.
volume.silent: Silent: turn it up to measure it
volume.back: Volumes go back to what they were when you finish.

mute.unsupported: {name} cannot be muted, so the other speakers cannot be measured one at a time while it is in the group. Skip them, or tune by ear in Manual tuning.
mute.unsupportedManual: {name} cannot be muted, so the other speakers cannot be heard alone. Everyone and {name} alone still work.
